risks.reason: Notification test (#48): Android 9 full pause and resume PASS (required check). Android 14: Pause PASS; Resume NOT TESTED, because Android 14 lets an app start a user-initiated download job from the background only after a real tap, which an automated PendingIntent.send() is not
risks.needs: Owner's phone: start a download, leave the app, Pause then Resume from the notification
risks.impact: The app side of pause/resume from the notification is tested on both emulators; the physical tap is not
risks.alternatives: Fix the test until the real scenario passes
risks.closes_when: Owner's tap on Resume from the notification on Android 14+ after installing (PRV-05, NVP15-CHG-0005)

risks.reason: Release run 44989102295 (custom-15, a3047e63): 14→15 and 12→15 with the real key PASS on Android 9 and 14, Android 8 refused. 13→15 not run as its own step (Build 13 shares Build 14's key). Data kept is checked on the emulator update with a seeded season queue; a fuller representative data set is open.
risks.impact: Data-keeping upgrade unproven until the release run
risks.closes_when: Upgrade from Build 13 run as its own step, and representative user data (settings, add-ons, profiles, downloads, queue, subtitle settings) seeded and checked after 12/13/14→15, before the next release (PRE-RELEASE REQUIRED)

closed.reason: B15-PLY-02: Nuvio's ExoPlayer add-on subtitle test failed once in 20 runs on Android 9
closed.closes_when: Root cause found or no recurrence over further runs
closed.evidence: Nuvio device tests since #51's diagnostics (2026-11-21 12:54 to 2026-11-22): 85 Android 9/14/16 jobs passed in 32 successful runs, each running MpvSurfaceTest, SubtitlePlaybackTest (both engines, ExoPlayer add-on subtitles) and SubtitleSettingsTest. Every failed run had a named cause: 44908042187 the rejected #55 change (mpv opened once; a real regression the tests caught), 44911126352 and 44917531198 new tests while written, 44931128379 the Android 16 wrong-thread fix (#63) and a stale test reading, 7 runs the Android 17 emulator image. No failure of these tests without a cause.
